relations: Expanding ripples on the lake surface progressively distort and break the mirrored reflection of the sky and green hills.
The crests of the spreading waves catch the ambient light as they widen across the water.
Ripples propagating toward the foreground reach the bank where fallen leaves rest, while the framing branches remain stationary.
caption: The video captures a tranquil lake ringed by lush green hills, with dark overhanging branches framing the left and right edges and the pale sky mirrored on the water. Ripples are already visible across the surface, with concentric rings near the middle becoming clearer as they spread. Over time, these rings widen, their crests catching the light and breaking up the smooth reflection of clouds and forested slopes. The rings expand toward the foreground, where fallen leaves rest near the bank, while the surrounding hills and branches remain fixed. The camera holds its position throughout. The expanding waves are the main visible motion in the scene.
